# QuantumDissipativeReservoir

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reservoir computing architecture that intentionally uses quantum dissipation (e.g., coupling to thermal baths) to shape its dynamics for computation. Enables topology-centric integration of quantum reservoirs into network substrates, where controlled dissipation can stabilize computation under varying load.
